description: Simplify agro self-upgrade to the smallest correct upgrade per released install kind, and remove the star prompt.

userStories.title: Remove the star prompt
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro sandbox install` to print no star prompt so that the CLI holds no promotional state.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/lib/star-prompt.ts` and `.agro/cli/src/lib/__tests__/star-prompt.test.ts` do not exist.
`git grep -n -i "star-prompt\|StarPrompt\|STAR_PROMPT" -- .agro/cli/src docs` prints no line.
`agro run -- pnpm --dir .agro/cli exec vitest run src/__tests__/sandbox.test.ts` exits 0.
Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Shrink the self-upgrade command
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one small upgrade path for each released install kind so that the command is easy to verify.
acceptanceCriteria: The npm path applies when the realpath of `argv[1]` contains `/node_modules/@mifune/agro/`. The command runs `npm i -g --prefix <owning prefix> @mifune/agro@latest`. It exits 0 only when npm exits 0. A test asserts the exact npm arguments.

The standalone path applies when the basename of the realpath of `argv[1]` is `agro` and the path is not under `node_modules/@mifune/agro/`. The command downloads `AGRO_JS_URL` (default `https://github.com/mifunedev/agro/releases/latest/download/agro.js`) and writes the file in the target directory with mode `0755`. It runs `--version` on the new file, then renames the new file over the target. A test asserts the new target content and mode.
When the first line of the current target is an absolute Node shebang (`#!/<path>/node`), the replaced target keeps that first line. A test asserts the kept line.

The command exits 1 when the downloaded file has no `#!` first line, or when its `--version` exits non-zero. Then the target bytes do not change, and no temporary file remains in the target directory. A test asserts each condition.

For each other target, the command exits 1 and writes nothing. Examples are `/opt/agro/dist/agro.js` and a checkout `dist/agro.js`. The command prints one line that names the target and tells the operator to upgrade with the mechanism that installed it.
With `--dry-run`, the command prints the planned npm command or the planned download URL, exits 0, and writes nothing.
`agro update` stays an alias of `agro self-upgrade`, and the vendor-flag refusals in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/cli-first-help.test.ts` and `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/bundle-identity.test.ts` still pass.
`wc -l .agro/cli/src/commands/self-upgrade.ts` prints a number less than or equal to 120.
`printSelfUpgradeHelp` in `.agro/cli/src/cli.ts` describes only the behavior in this story.
`agro run -- pnpm --dir .agro/cli exec vitest run src/__tests__/self-upgrade.test.ts src/__tests__/cli-first-help.test.ts src/__tests__/bundle-identity.test.ts` exits 0.
Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Update documentation and changelog
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the documentation to state the new upgrade behavior so that the documentation matches the code.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` § Upgrading the CLI and `docs/installation.md` describe only the behavior of US-002. Neither file mentions `.prev`, a downgrade refusal, or a PATH shadow refusal.
`docs/configuration.md` has no `AGRO_NO_STAR_PROMPT` row.
`CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` has entries for the simpler self-upgrade and the star prompt removal.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh docs/lifecycle-commands.md docs/installation.md` reports no new finding compared with `development`.

userStories.title: Record the sandbox routing replay again
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the routing replay fixture to match the changed instruction files so that `sandbox-routing.test.ts` passes.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/sandbox-routing/decisions.json` holds 17 decisions, R1 to R17. A fresh decision-only agent produced each decision against the final instruction files.
Each decision matches its oracle in `cases.json`.
The provenance equals the output of `sourceProvenance()` on the final tree.
`agro run -- pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/sandbox-routing.test.ts` exits 0.

userStories.title: Capture manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a command transcript of the branch CLI so that I can see each upgrade path work.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/simplify-self-upgrade/evidence/manual-review.md` holds a transcript of the built branch CLI. Each run uses `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js self-upgrade` on a copy in a new temp directory.
Each standalone run sets `AGRO_JS_URL` inline to a local HTTP artifact.
The transcript shows three runs: `--dry-run` for an npm-shaped path, a standalone upgrade with the pinned shebang, and the refusal of a checkout `dist/agro.js`.
The transcript shows that `agro sandbox install` code has no star prompt line (`git grep` output).
The story creates no live resource and deletes each temp directory that it creates.
